specification_anchor_refs.heading: ### 14. Vector Live Effects
specification_anchor_refs.verbatim: [STU-FX-030] The document raster-effect resolution/color-model/background/anti-aliasing settings are a document-level `StudioEffectStack` policy applied by every raster effect used on vector art. SVG-filter effects are an XML-defined interchange path (import/apply/edit) preserved for `.svg` round-trip (14.13) and are adapter-neutral (native evaluation where the filter primitives map to native passes).

specification_anchor_refs.heading: ### 2. Effect Application, Masking, Blending, and Ordering
specification_anchor_refs.verbatim: [STU-FX-009] A "repeat last effect" affordance re-applies the most recent `StudioLiveFilter` kind + parameters to the current selection as a new stack entry; a "repeat with new settings" variant opens the parameter surface first. This is one deduped command, not two menu items.

inputs.name: RasterEffectRequest
inputs.type_and_units: DocumentRevision, immutable source VectorAppearanceRef, EffectEntryId/kind/typed parameters, DocRasterPolicyRevision/resolution with explicit unit, explicit StudioColorProfile/sample model, background colour with profile, anti-alias enum and source/resource grants

inputs.name: selection
inputs.provider: Actual CPU rasterizer and native-mapped SVG passes must bind exact canonical owner/source/dependency lock; absence is NON_EXECUTABLE, no private vector/XML/stack owner.

implementation_steps.step: Consume immutable geometry/appearance and XML-defined mapped-pass descriptor from MT-296's Nib/effect owner; validate profile, policy revision, resource grants and resolution-unit conversion. Pigment neither parses/rewrites editable SVG nor duplicates geometry/effect stack ownership.

Resolve output extent from document geometry and bound resolution-unit conversion, allocate checked tiles/sample layout, and carry document colour model/profile/background/anti-alias policy into every consumed raster-on-vector pass. Policy revision invalidates raster cache keys; stale cached output cannot survive settings change.

Evaluate actual CPU/native-mapped SVG primitives into live raster appearance artifact with source/policy/effect digests. Unsupported primitive emits typed unsupported/loss receipt, never silently flattens XML/source or claims complete SVG parity. Original vector source and editable XML remain byte-identical.

Existing stack owner supplies repeated last-effect kind/settings as a distinct new entry; consume same/new settings without replacing old entries. Pigment returns candidate tiles and diagnostics to shared Controls/UserManual/Observe, leaving authoritative promotion, native UI and host admission to MT-36195.

expected_outputs.type_and_units: RasterAppearanceProposal of checked document-pixel extent/sample format/profile-bound tiles, source/effect/policy revision and unsupported loss receipts
expected_outputs.failure_outcome: Invalid units/profile, unsupported required pass, denied/lost source, cancelled budget or stale revision produces typed no-result; source XML/vector/artifact/history unchanged; corrected owner request/current grants permit bounded retry.
expected_outputs.unresolved_prerequisites: Exact CPU rasterizer/native SVG pass mapping, resolution-unit conversion, anti-alias/background/colour-model semantics and independent actual raster/XML source oracle pins unresolved.
